title: Baked Lamb Kibbeh
description: A traditional Syrian dish made with ground lamb, mixed with spices and baked to perfection. This recipe is perfect for a hearty dinner or special occasion.

ingredients.name: Spices
ingredients.amount: 1 teaspoon ground allspice, 1 teaspoon ground cumin, 1/2 teaspoon salt, 1/4 teaspoon black pepper

instructions: In a large mixing bowl, combine ground lamb, bulghur, onion, spices, olive oil, and garlic. Mix well.
Transfer the mixture to a baking dish and shape into a round or oval shape.
Bake for 45 minutes or until the kibbeh is golden brown and cooked through.
Let the kibbeh rest for 10 minutes before slicing and serving.
